Application Description

Designed by a musician, AeroPads offers professional and inspiring ambient pads. Elevate your live sound with immersive pads and keep your team locked in time with precise metronome clicks. Trusted by professional musicians– from small stages to sold-out stadiums– AeroPads are the best-sounding pads on the market, widely praised for being harmonically intricate and versatile without sounding boring or stagnant. Ambient pads add depth and dimension to revitalize your mix and eliminate dead space and awkward transitions. AeroPads is a space-inspired ambient pad player designed to accompany and underscore live musical performances of many kinds. Operation is simple: 1. Select a Key. 2. Select a Patch. 3. Play. AeroPads is widely used for weddings, cinematic scores, worship services, songwriting sessions, rehearsals, open mics, studio tracks, and chill ambient arrangements. Ambient pads are often used with acoustic guitar, electric guitar, and piano, but are equally compatible with instruments such as violin, cello, synthesizers, ukulele, harp, and more. AeroPads feature enough harmonic movement and texture to fill out solo performances while remaining restrained enough to accompany full bands. Ambient pads can help you feel more relaxed and prepared on stage, so you can focus on the performance. Designed by Aerospace Audio, AeroPads feature the same sounds and similar features that power the iconic foot-controlled instrument: Atmosphere. Highlighted Features: ∙ Expressive ambient pads in all 12 keys and 3 common tonalities: Major, Minor, and Neutral. ∙ Smooth, adjustable crossfades for seamless transitions. ∙ Built-in metronome clicks with visual and audible cues to keep you in time– and a panic button to ditch the click if your team drifts tempo or skips a beat. ∙ Customizable Patch Slots and Patch Pages so that your favorite presets are always within reach. ∙ Programmable setlists recall each song’s pad selection, key, tonality, tempo, time signature, click sound, and individual level settings. ∙ Independent overall, pad, and click levels and presets provide precise control for rehearsals, recording, and live performance. ∙ Adjustable concert pitch tuning for a variety of reference pitches, including 440 Hz, 432 Hz, 444 Hz, 442 Hz, and more. ∙ AirPlay support. ∙ Independent pad and click routing send pads to the speakers and clicks to in-ear monitors. ∙ Expandable sound library with additional sound packs available for purchase. ∙ Mono, stereo, and split-channel routing options. ∙ Optimized for both iPhone and iPad. Note from Isaac, the designer: "I hope you enjoy using AeroPads as much as I do. I designed AeroPads because most of the available pad players and ambient pads that I tried felt boring and uninspiring. Don’t get me wrong, there’s definitely some cool stuff out there, but I never fell in love with any of it. The apps that I tried were honestly a bit clunky and confusing. And most of the ambient pads that I heard were either repetitive, boring, or just wildly distracting.
